qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Scale economies shared via the premier North American B2B MRO distribution network. Unrivaled next-day/same-day SKU availability across millions of maintenance products creates an insurmountable logistics moat. Customers are highly price-insensitive because downtime costs far exceed component prices. Proved by 10-year median ROIC of ~40% (operating ROIC >45%) and resilient gross margins (~39%). Primary erosion risk is long-term disintermediation from digital marketplaces (e.g., Amazon Business) in non-critical commodity SKUs.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Unchallenged North American leader in MRO distribution with an entrenched distribution network, automated KeepStock inventory solutions, and high-frequency mission-critical parts availability. Structural beneficiary of US manufacturing reshoring and automation. Stellar capital allocator with 54+ consecutive years of dividend growth, conservative leverage (net debt <1.1x net income, interest coverage >30x), and ~40% ROIC across cycles. [5-10Y g: high-touch MRO volume 3.5% + endless assortment (Zoro/MonotaRO) 3.0% + contract pricing 2.0% - industrial cyclical drag 0.5% + share repurchases 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year financial record demonstrates peerless capital efficiency: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 39.7% and operating ROIC of 46.5%. Free cash flow conversion averages 85-95% of GAAP net income ($1.62B Owner FCF in FY2025). Peak-to-peak earnings power grew from $9.96 in 2016 to $38.96 in 2024. Robust balance sheet with $2.36B LT debt vs. $585M cash ($1.78B net debt), amortizable in ~1.0 year of net income, with interest coverage exceeding 30x EBIT/Interest.
